extracted.intended_audience: current and prospective listeners/fans of the Welcome to Night Vale fiction podcast
extracted.subtask_description: A promotional/homepage description for a serialized fiction podcast that explains the show's format, tone, distribution, and ways for listeners to engage or support it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Podcast format and recurring content elements
rubrics_metrics.description: WELCOME TO NIGHT VALE is a twice-monthly podcast in the style of community updates for the small desert town of Night Vale, featuring local weather, news, announcements from the Sheriff's Secret Police, mysterious lights in the night sky, dark hooded figures with unknowable powers, and cultural events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page frames these specific elements (weather, news, Sheriff's Secret Police announcements, mysterious lights, dark hooded figures, cultural events) as the core content that defines the show's episodes and voice; frequency is specified as twice-monthly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone and genre blend
rubrics_metrics.description: The show is described via press quotes as 'the foundational institution of the fiction-podcast genre' and praised for an 'uncanny blend of the macabre and the mundane' and as 'a place where a love of the bizarre meets a love of language.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These descriptions indicate the expected tone: an interplay of the surreal/macabre with ordinary community-radio style delivery and a linguistic/ stylistic emphasis. This functions as an implicit standard for writing/producing episodes (blend strangeness with mundane specificity; value of language/style).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution, accessibility, and audience engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Listeners are instructed to 'Turn on your radio and hide' and to subscribe on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Podcast Addict, or RSS; Episode Transcripts can be found here; Welcome to Night Vale is part of the Night Vale Presents network; become a member and support the show!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page signals production/distribution expectations: multi-platform availability, release schedule, provision of transcripts for accessibility, and avenues for audience support (membership, sponsors). These are practical standards for making the show reachable and sustaining it financially.
